pages.text: $(thing)FirmaLife HardCore$() has completely rewritten the cellar and greenhouse mechanics. $(l)A Climate Station is no longer required$().$(br2)The vanilla Firmalife Climate Station recipe has been removed. Instead, the mod uses a $(l)fully automatic space detection system$() — simply enclose an area with qualifying blocks, and the system will automatically detect it and grant preservation or greenhouse effects to containers inside.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: $(li)When you place or break wall/container blocks, the system automatically scans the surrounding area.$()$(br)$(li)Once an enclosed space is detected, it calculates the average thermal resistance of the walls and derives the indoor effective temperature from the outdoor temperature.$()$(br)$(li)All $(l:firmalife/food_shelves)Food Shelves$(), $(l:firmalife/hangers)Hangers$(), and Large Vessels inside automatically receive the appropriate preservation trait.$()$(br)$(li)One space is rechecked every 5 seconds to keep state synchronized.$()

pages.title: Debug Commands
pages.text: $(thing)/flhc cellar info$()$(br)View cellar/greenhouse detection details at your current position.$(br2)$(thing)/flhc cellar list$()$(br)List all tracked spaces in the current dimension.$(br2)$(thing)/flhc cellar recalc$()$(br)Force a rescan at your position (requires permission level 4).$(br2)$(thing)/flhc cellar clear$()$(br)Clear all tracked space caches (requires permission level 4).
